basic_details.job_title: GMCH Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Biochemistry, Government Medical College & Hospital (GMCH), Sector 32, Chandigarh, has invited applications for one Project Assistant on a purely temporary basis in the project "Establishment of DBT NIDAN KENDRA", under Principal Investigator Dr Shivani Jaswal. The pay is Rs 20000/- pm + HRA, the essential qualification is BSc in Basic Sciences, and the age limit is Upto 35 years. The filled application form with self-attested documents is to be submitted latest by 23 November 2026, 5.00 p.m., in the Department of Biochemistry.

important_dates.interview_date: Will be intimated through email only

how_to_apply: Eligible candidates should apply with the attached application form and all self-attested supportive documents/testimonials, latest by 23/11/2026, 5.00 p.m. The application goes to the Department of Biochemistry, Dr. Shivani Jaswal, Professor & Head, Principal Investigator, Block-E, Level-4, GMCH, Sector 32, Chandigarh.

The application form is given at the end of the notice. It asks for name, father's name, date of birth, age, gender, complete residential address, mobile number, email ID, education (degree, college, university, marks %, attempt) and work experience (post, place of work, from and to dates, work profile). It ends with date, place and signature, and a line to attach self-attested copies of the required certificates.

content_sections.heading: About the Project
content_sections.text: The post sits in the Department of Biochemistry of Government Medical College and Hospital, Sector 32, Chandigarh. The project, "Establishment of DBT NIDAN KENDRA", is run at GMCH Chandigarh under Dr Shivani Jaswal, Professor & Head of the department, who is the Principal Investigator.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The age limit is Upto 35 years. The notice prints no age cut-off date and no age relaxation. A candidate who is working somewhere must get an NOC from the concerned Department of the Institute. For the full eligibility, candidates should refer to the official notification.

rows.desirable: Experience of lab work in the field of molecular analysis

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Project Assistant is paid Rs 20000/- pm + HRA. The engagement runs from the date of appointment till the remaining period of the project and is purely on contract basis, temporary in nature. The notice mentions no allowance other than HRA.

content_sections.heading: GMCH Project Assistant Job Description
content_sections.text: The project involves lab work/sample collection and data analysis. Appointed staff may have to work in emergency situations, field visits and travel outstation.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GMCH Project Assistant
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates should apply with the attached application form and all self-attested supportive documents/testimonials, latest by 23/11/2026, 5.00 p.m. The application goes to the Department of Biochemistry, Dr. Shivani Jaswal, Professor & Head, Principal Investigator, Block-E, Level-4, GMCH, Sector 32, Chandigarh. The application form is given at the end of the notice. It asks for name, father's name, date of birth, age, gender, complete residential address, mobile number, email ID, education (degree, college, university, marks %, attempt) and work experience (post, place of work, from and to dates, work profile). It ends with date, place and signature, and a line to attach self-attested copies of the required certificates. Documents named in the notice: Filled application form Date of Birth Certificate (self-attested copy) Essential qualification certificates (self-attested copy) Experience certificate if any (self-attested copy) NOC, if applicable Passport size Photo

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted on the basis of higher educational qualification, work experience and/or screening test, if required. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for the interview/written test. Fulfilling the essential qualification or experience does not guarantee a call for interview. The date of the interview/test will be intimated through email only. No separate letter for the screening test or interview will be issued individually. The notice advises candidates to keep in continuous contact with the GMCH website ( www.gmch.gov.in , www.gmch.nic.in ) for updates. The waiting list is valid for one year.

faq.question: Q1. How many Project Assistant posts are there at GMCH Chandigarh?
faq.answer: There is 1 post of Project Assistant in the project "Establishment of DBT NIDAN KENDRA" at GMCH Chandigarh.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the GMCH Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The application must be submitted latest by 23 November 2026, 5.00 p.m., in the Department of Biochemistry.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the GMCH Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is BSc in Basic Sciences. Experience of lab work in the field of molecular analysis is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the GMCH Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The age limit is Upto 35 years. The notice prints no age relaxation.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the GMCH Project Assistant?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs 20000/- pm + HRA, so HRA is paid in addition to the Rs 20000/- pm.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the GMCH Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Submit the attached application form with self-attested documents and a passport size photo to the Department of Biochemistry, Dr. Shivani Jaswal, Block-E, Level-4, GMCH, Sector 32, Chandigarh, by the last date.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Candidates will be shortlisted on higher educational qualification, work experience and/or a screening test, if required. Only shortlisted candidates are called for the interview/written test.

faq.question: Q8. Is the GMCH Project Assistant job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is purely on contract basis, temporary in nature, for the remaining period of the project, with no right to regular appointment or permanent absorption.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview or for joining the post.

faq.question: Q10. Is an NOC needed to apply?
faq.answer: An NOC is needed if the candidate is working somewhere. It must be obtained from the concerned Department of the Institute.
